question.text: Under SEBI buyback regulations, within how many working days of the closure of the buyback must the company pay shareholders?

explanation.text: The Logic: Payment must be made to shareholders whose shares have been accepted in the buy-back, or share certificates returned for shares not accepted, within 5 working days from the closure of the buy-back offer. The Trap: Candidates may confuse this with the overall buyback completion deadline rather than the post-closure payment/return-of-certificates window. Note: The 5-working-day rule applies to both payment for accepted shares and return of certificates for rejected shares.
